meta.title: Relgari Train Tickets
meta.description: A friendlier way to book train tickets in Bangladesh. Search trains, pick your seat on a clear coach map and carry a QR ticket on your phone.

nav.logoutBody: You will need to log in again to hold seats or see your tickets.

hero.badgeText: A calmer way to book trains
hero.lead: Search, pick your exact seat on a clear coach map, pay, and carry a QR ticket on your phone. Built for Bangladesh's railways, in Bangla and English.

departures.title: See what is leaving, at a glance
departures.body: The next trains from the station you pick, with the seats on sale right now in each class, so you decide before you tap.
departures.empty: No more departures from this station today or tomorrow.
departures.error: The board could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
departures.note: Seat counts are live. More seats open every two days at 5:00 PM, and the count drops as seats are held or bought.

seats.title: Pick your exact seat, like on the real coach
seats.body: The map follows the railway's own coaches: two seats, the aisle, two seats, and a table in the middle. AC coaches are drawn cabin by cabin. Tap a seat to try it. To book, start from the search at the top.

points.t: Free, yours and taken seats look different, so you never guess.
Coach, seat numbers and the table match the railway's map.
Pick up to 4 seats and they stay yours while you pay.

seats.note: Preview only. Seats are not held here.

how.title: Four stops from search to ticket

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Pick where you are going and when. No account needed to look.

steps.title: Choose seats
steps.text: Tap up to 4 seats on the coach map. They are held for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Pay
steps.text: Pay with bKash, Nagad, Rocket or a card.

steps.title: Get your QR
steps.text: Your ticket is in My tickets. Cancel seats there if plans change.

cta.title: Ready for a smoother journey?
cta.text: Start with a search. It takes less than a minute.

footer.tagline: A friendlier way to book train tickets. রেলে ভ্রমণ হোক সহজ।
footer.fine: Relgari is a personal concept project. It is not affiliated with Bangladesh Railway, and no real tickets are sold.
